body: You're invited to join Business Partners Program: metabusinesspartnersupport.com Meta Team invited you to join the Business Partners Program: metabusinesspartnersupport.com business portfolio. Portfolios connect a business’s Facebook Pages and other business assets so you can manage them all in one place. You won’t be able to accept the invitation after this date. You may need to log in with your managed Meta account if it's required by your organization.
